info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Loan Application Collaterals API
info.description: This API endpoint allows for the removal of specific collaterals associated with a loan application. By providing the loan application identifier and the collateral ID, users can effectively manage collateral documentation within their system. Typical consumers include financial institutions and loan processing software that need to keep loan application records updated. This operation is crucial for ensuring that obsolete or incorrect collaterals are efficiently deleted from the system, maintaining data integrity and compliance.

delete.summary: Remove collateral from a loan application.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific collateral associated with a given loan application. By providing the loan application ID and the collateral ID, you can remove the collateral from the system, ensuring that the loan application reflects the current collateral status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific collateral associated with the loan application identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the collateral you intend to delete is correctly specified.
